skills.name: I'm the Black Knights' Ace
skills.description: Poses and smiles.  Good effects on allies.    *Cancels continuous damage  *HP +300% (7 sec) *HP x 30% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec)

skills.name: Radiant Wave Surge System
skills.description: Summons Guren Flight-Enabled Version and  fires the Radiant Wave Surge System.  Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Enemy Critical Rate -40% (5 sec) *ATK per sec x 1000% Area Damage (5 sec)

abilities.name: Group: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion
abilities.description: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Intelligence
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Intelligence type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
